title: sukuna abilities
description: adds sukuna's abilities to the game
body:
this datapack adds sukuna (from jujutsu kaisen anime) abilities including slash, cleave, shrine, divine flames, malevolent shrine

## guide

enter the command:
```
/tag <name> add sukuna
```
 then enter:
```
/function sk:sukuna
```
**make sure the enable cheats in your world**

**only one person can be sukuna**

## abilities

slash: damages mobs/players infront of the player. 

(cooldown: 2 seconds)

![slash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/344d1e93bf37f8c683deed3076d19c6c92f079c0.gif)

cleave: damages mobs/players touching the player.

(cooldown: 5 seconds)

![cleave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf61e9b6bce410d3456631c988df93a24be5a986.gif)

shrine: damages mobs/players near the player.

(cooldown: 15 seconds)

![shrine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f25d7f0ff3d4cc2a35bbaa05138f12c2356a9748.gif)

divine flames : shoots an flammable-explosive "arrow".

(cooldown: 30 seconds)

![divine flames](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/373589f8e8beaa394e821de12d9d31adf78a418d.gif)

malevolent shrine: damages mobs/players around the player. (less than 50 blocks)

(cooldown: 60 seconds)

![domain expansion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f6ee61d7a284f2fc31225f66e4b87677f7f0c37.gif)
